**0.75h**

### 2026-10-18 – I finished modeling my marble course and It took me a long time because I didnt know what the dimensions of the ball was and forgot how to make tracks so I had to relearn how to do that and then I fin

**5.5h**

I finished modeling my marble course and It took me a long time because I didnt know what the dimensions of the ball was and forgot how to make tracks so I had to relearn how to do that and then I finished the tracks but I realized I didnt have space for the zig zag marble course part so I decided not to include that and then I also had to fix the issue where the track wasnt aligned with the funnel and also the track wasnt going through properly to the plinko part and then I didnt know whether to start the stair from the bottom or not, and after all of that I had to make sure the entire thing was under 100 mm by 100 mm by 100 mm that I had decided it should be.

### 2026-10-18 – I first made my repo with the pictures in the readme and the stl file in cad section and then I searched up vendors for the 3d printing but that took a while because there were so many options but i n

**0.75h**

I first made my repo with the pictures in the readme and the stl file in cad section and then I searched up vendors for the 3d printing but that took a while because there were so many options but i noticed that a lot of them overcharged so I looked in the slack what other people were doing and realized they were doing the printing through the 3d printing legion ysws and so I texted there and someone responded to my request and we went back and forth with part descriptions and prices so in total it was 10.2.  The first image is the texts between me and the person in 3d printing legion and the second image is one of the 3d printing companies that I saw people were using as an alternative to 3d printing legion.
